items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I got a chance to record with him and he’s responsible for getting me on some records

ctx.x: That’s interesting and I was also looking at this, you had quite an association with Rick Fay.

Rick Fay, yes. I didn’t get a chance to meet him until the last 10 or 15 years. I didn’t know him before, but I got a chance to record with him and he’s responsible for getting me on some records and things like that. Great tenor player and soprano and clarinetist.
Where do you feel you fit in to the sound of your fellow clarinetists. Do you emulate anybody? Were you highly influenced by anybody besides Joe Marsala?
